title: Role of expectation in open-label placebos
summary: Recent studies have shown that placebos can be effective even when patients know that they are receiving a placebo. The mechanisms behind these open-label placebos are still unclear. This study on psychological well-being aims to investigate the role of expectation when given open-label placebos for five days.

interventions.name: Open-label placebos with information (placebos for five days, two each day)
Open-label placebos without information (placebos for five days, two each day)
